event.text: I recommend review by a Counsel clinician in this thread, with a same-day service-hours target; spinning triggered by head movement that settles usually needs a clinician to confirm the cause and advise next steps. Call 911 if you develop new weakness, numbness, slurred speech, vision loss, trouble walking, or a sudden severe headache. Seek same-day care if the spinning becomes constant or new hearing loss or vomiting develops.
